name: Parachute status and release
description: Parachute state and health from PAYLOAD_STATE, and the MAV_CMD_DO_PARACHUTE-backed enable, disable, and release actions.

properties.name: Deployment state
properties.description: PAYLOAD_STATE.activation_state for this function: DISARMED while auto-release is disabled, including after a release, ARMING while it is being enabled and ARMED while it is enabled, both only while the parachute is packed, ACTIVATING during a release, COMPLETED while auto-release is enabled after a release, until the parachute is repacked or auto-release is disabled, and UNKNOWN when the state is unknown or not reported.

bindings.correlation: payload_id, instance_epoch, and function_id of this function, from the manager's original system and component IDs

properties.name: Health
properties.description: PAYLOAD_STATE.health for this function, including UNKNOWN when health is unknown or not reported.

bindings.correlation: payload_id, instance_epoch, and function_id of this function, from the manager's original system and component IDs

actions.name: Disable auto-release
actions.description: Sends PARACHUTE_DISABLE, so crash detection no longer releases the parachute.

bindings.correlation: COMMAND_ACK for MAV_CMD_DO_PARACHUTE from the bound target component, per the Command Protocol; param1 is PARACHUTE_DISABLE

actions.name: Enable auto-release
actions.description: Sends PARACHUTE_ENABLE, so crash detection can release the parachute.

bindings.correlation: COMMAND_ACK for MAV_CMD_DO_PARACHUTE from the bound target component, per the Command Protocol; param1 is PARACHUTE_ENABLE

actions.name: Release
actions.description: Sends PARACHUTE_RELEASE, which releases the parachute and stops the motors. The autopilot applies its own release checks, including the minimum release altitude.

bindings.correlation: COMMAND_ACK for MAV_CMD_DO_PARACHUTE from the bound target component, per the Command Protocol; param1 is PARACHUTE_RELEASE
